entities.name: Hamath
entities.description: City on Corondor on Dominaria, northernmost on the Tenamis River, ruled by a Council of Guides; lost to Ravidel in the Planeswalker War.

entities.name: Kadesha
entities.description: Visionary with magical power who leads the Guides of Hamath.

entities.name: Hamath Guard
entities.description: Triumvirate of guards enforcing the Guides' will.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Planeswalker who advanced on many fronts, attacked Hamath, and opened a sinkhole beneath it.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Wayfarer who fought Hamath's champions and later made Hamath his side's home base.

entities.name: Élan d'Avenant
entities.description: Sent by the Kadesha after Jared.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Planeswalker who rang the gray chime, destroying Telemar City.

entities.name: Telemar City
entities.description: City destroyed by the gray chime.

entities.name: Planeswalker War
entities.description: War in which Hamath was attacked and lost.

events.summary: After Ravidel's defeat at Castle Melmereth, Jared Carthalion appears on Hamath's plains; the Kadesha sends a thunder spirit, which is defeated.
events.quote: the Kadesha sent a thunder spirit out to do battle with him

events.summary: Jared brawls in Rifa's Inn, destroying it with magic.
events.quote: immediately getting into a brawl in Rifa's Inn

events.summary: Élan d'Avenant fights Jared atop the Ziggurat; Kristina of the Woods teleports Jared away.
events.quote: Kristina of the Woods intervened, teleporting Jared away

events.summary: During the Planeswalker War Ravidel attacks Hamath, defended by Freyalise and the Kadesha.
events.quote: warily defended by Freyalise and the Kadesha, the city stood strong

events.summary: After Leshrac destroys Telemar City, Ravidel teleports to Hamath and opens a sinkhole; Hamath is lost.
events.quote: Ravidel teleported to Hamath, opening a sinkhole beneath it
